EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your interest in the interdisciplinary studies program at ASU!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for expressing interest in the interdisciplinary studies MA program at Arizona State University. This is an innovative and flexible degree program designed for students who wish to pursue a unique educational experience by combining the study of two or more disciplines. Founded on the conviction that solving problems and producing knowledge in the twenty-first century often requires the crossing of disciplinary boundaries, the program provides exposure to a variety of research methods, historical perspectives and modes of inquiry. The MAIS program offers access to faculty members who are active practitioners of interdisciplinary inquiry and recognized leaders in their fields of study. For more information about the program feel free to review the MAIS Program Handbook. https://newcollege.asu.edu/sites/default/files/files/advising/documents/mais_graduate_handbook_2015-2016.pdf
Be sure to review our application checklist found here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B44BICxe1BtdZEoxNDd3SEZCQWs/view?usp=sharing for more information about the application process in an easy to follow format, and peruse our sample schedule to explore the flexible curriculum available for both full-time and part-time students. Also, please take a moment to check out our new e-magazine on our site and see all the exciting work being done by our faculty and students.
It's important to find the right fit in graduate school. A great way to learn more about this degree is to register for one of our upcoming information sessions. You can view the dates on our site, then just email me to RSVP for any date you plan to attend.
Kindest regards, Graduate Studies
New College of Interdisciplinary Arts and Sciences Arizona State University, West campus nc.gradstudies@asu.edu
